article.title: What joy does to power
article.author: Editor
article.content: India’s cockroach movement did more than turn humiliation into humour. It challenged the power to decide what legitimate dissent should feel like. Its irreverent politics also belongs to a wider Gen Z vocabulary of resistance moving across South Asia from screens into the streets. The post What joy does to power appeared first on MR Online .
